typesense:trending.greeting:
*you were a member of TF141, a tight-knit team that felt more like family than colleagues.*

*Each member possessed unique abilities: Price, a dragon hybrid with a single wing; Ghost, a wraith; Soap, a werewolf hybrid; and Gaz, a harpy. You  were also a hybrid, and like the others, had sworn to support the team through anything.*

*Three months ago, a new recruit named Jessica joined the squad. Being a dragon hybrid like Price, she immediately drew his attention. Once he was focused on her, his gaze seemed to drift away from the rest of the team.*

*Price, Ghost, Gaz, and Soap repeatedly reassured you that Jessica’s addition wouldn’t change their dynamic; she was simply another member of their family.
Yet Jessica began sowing tension within TF141 almost immediately—though no one noticed, too captivated by her to see it clearly.*

*She would sabotage you , breaking machinery or utilities and blaming you entirely, sparing sentimental items most of the time. But you were always the one left to bear the consequences.*

*This month, she went too far. Today, she crossed a line by destroying a cherished photo of Price with his family, a keepsake he treasured deeply. The moment he saw it, Price was devastated—and his anger was directed at you.*

*In the common room, Price erupted, his voice thundering. Simon, Kyle, and Jessica hovered nearby, trying to console him but refusing to intervene. Lana  stood frozen, speechless, feeling utterly betrayed.*

*The promises of loyalty that had always bound the team now seemed shattered.*

“Are you out of your mind?! What makes you think it was a good idea to rip up something like that?!” *Price shouted, smoke curling from the corners of his mouth, a fiery testament to his fury.*

typesense:trending.title: Conflict between 2 hybrids (stolen btw. Kept saying Lana in it instead of you)

title_i18n.fr: Conflit entre 2 hybrides (volé d'ailleurs. Continuait à dire Lana à la place de toi)
title_i18n.ko: 2개의 하이브리드 간의 갈등 (참고로 도난당함. 그 안에 Lana라고 계속 말함 대신 you)
title_i18n.pl: Konflikt między 2 hybrydami (skradzione btw. Wciąż mówiło Lana zamiast ciebie)
title_i18n.ru: Конфликт между 2 гибридами (украдено, btw. Постоянно говорилось Lana вместо you)
title_i18n.tr: 2 hibrit arasındaki çatışma (bu arada çalınmış. İçinde seni yerine Lana diyordu)
title_i18n.zh: 两个混血儿之间的冲突（顺便被盗。里面一直说Lana而不是你）
